action_policy.title: Action permissions
action_policy.description: Rules authorize automatic actions. Disabled capabilities and read-only settings always take precedence.
action_policy.rule_required: A matching rule or approval is required.
action_policy.approval_help: Review these exact arguments. Approval applies once and expires after ten minutes.
action_policy.unknown: Outcome unknown. Verify its state before repeating the action.
action_policy.admin_only: Only administrators can change rules and approve actions.
action_policy.save_hint: Save changes before testing the rules.
action_policy.enabled_help: Your own rules automatically allow or deny individual actions. Disabled capabilities and read-only settings always take precedence.
